note: Animals, step B (Radar; Steve-approved plan 2026-10-21, design items/ANIMALS_DESIGN.md): one species, the rabbit. Server-owned records, no physics; they walk with the shared steering module (src/shared/steering.gd). Each player keeps up to target_per_player of a species within active_radius_m; new ones appear spawn_min_m to spawn_max_m from the player (out of sight) and never within never_within_m of any player; none are saved. Beyond active_radius_m from every player an animal is frozen (not ticked); beyond despawn_m it is dropped. Tick rates by distance to the nearest player: hz_near within near_m, hz_mid within mid_m, hz_far beyond. AI work per server tick is capped at tick_budget_ms (a quarter of the animals are looked at each tick, the rest wait). Caps: per_player_cap animals counted near one player, server_cap in all. Rabbit: grazes, hops a few metres, bolts away from a player within spook_m until safe_m, then settles. No hunting yet (damage and carcass come next). Deer (species 2, build 478): live in herds of 3 to 6; when one bolts the others follow after alarm_s seconds (the first to see a player is the sentinel). Health 20: three spear jabs. Build 480 (Tyler report 16): an animal that notices a player within alert_m (but not yet spook_m) freezes and watches for alert_s, then relaxes or bolts; a bolt zigzags (zig_deg every zig_leg_m), sprints for burst_s and then trots at trot_share of the sprint speed; herd members that stray beyond herd_pull_m graze back toward the herd centre.
